column1: # soundness/known_open_handoff.tsv — the KNOWN-OPEN register for soundness/run_handoff.sh. Its own file because
# soundness/baseline.sh regenerates known_open.tsv from the two property gates and would drop these.
# kind h — soundness/run_handoff.sh (gen_drop.py --handoff), MEASURED over the full 120-cell grid at
# candor-rust rustagent-v049 (published 0.40.6: 23 silent cells; this set: 6). Executed GT 1 drop each.
#   closure-param target in TAIL position: `let f = |_h: H| {}; f(V)` — the callee is a local VALUE,
#     so R200's unit-callee rule refuses it and the argument stays on the escape spine.
#   qret + generic / closure, direct: `let x = callee(H::new(), n)?; Ok(x)` — R194 exempts the by-value
#     argument on the `?` operand's spine because the callee is supposed to carry the charge, and a
#     generic parameter or a closure parameter cannot (R1121's stated residual).
